text:
Alicia Chen: hi all — I’m Alicia (started last week, infra team). I’m on the pager rotation starting Mon and want to confirm runbook access + shadow pairing. I tried opening the runbook index but get a 403. Who do I poke for permissions and a shadow slot? :wave:

Ben K.: welcome! :tada: quick steps: 1) fill the access request (https://wiki.internal/access-requests — choose 'oncall-runbooks'). 2) ping me here with the PRR id and I’ll add you to PagerDuty schedule. 3) we usually do 2x 2-hour shadow shifts before solo.

Alicia Chen: thanks — I submitted request id PRR-4982. Can you confirm once you’ve added me? Also, is there a recommended quick checklist to review before shadowing?

Ben K.: got it, PRR-4982. I’ll add you after 0900 UTC tomorrow. Checklist (short):
- read "Incident lifecycle" runbook (search: `incident-lifecycle.md`)
- skim top-5 infra runbooks for services you own
- run the pager delivery test (see command below)
- join the onboarding shadow session on calendar (I’ll invite)

Priya S.: hi Alicia — I’m happy to be your shadow. I’m free Wed 11–1 PST or Thu 3–5 PST. We’ll do one simulated page and one real shadow. For the simulation we use `oncall-sim` in #eng-oncall-sim.

Alicia Chen: Wed 11–1 PST works great. How do I run the pager delivery test?

Morgan L.: Alicia — gave you read + comment access to the runbook repo a few minutes ago (checked on the ACLs). You should receive an email. If you still get a 403, try clearing cookies or incognito, then ping me and I’ll do a manual share.

DevOpsBot: Access grant: user "Alicia Chen" added to group "oncall-runbooks" by Morgan L. (audit id: 5a7c9).

Ben K.: Pager delivery test — run locally: ```
# trigger test page to yourself
pd trigger --user "alicia.chen@redwood.com" --note "oncall test"
```
Or use the web UI: PagerDuty -> Services -> "Oncall Tests" -> Trigger -> choose your email. Confirm you get the notification (mobile + email). If you don’t get it within 60s, tag @Ben K. here.

Priya S.: Also FYI for the shadow: we follow the runbook strictly for severity triage. If you’re unsure, escalate to me (pager -> reply-all) or ping Ben. Post-incident we always open a short timeline in the incident tracker and add any runbook gaps to the runbook PR.

Alicia Chen: got the email and the PD test came through — mobile + email both. Thanks Morgan + Ben. I accepted the calendar invite for Wed. One more question: will I get edit rights to runbooks or just read/comment during probation?

Morgan L.: default is comment during the first 2 rotations. After you’ve done 2 shadows and 1 solo with no major errors, you get edit rights. If you’re doing a runbook PR earlier, we’ll request a review from the runbook owners and a dev reviewer.

OncallBot: Reminder: new-oncall checklist assigned to Alicia Chen. Items: Read runbooks, PD test, Shadow session, 1 simulated page. Due: 3 days from assignment.

Alicia Chen: perfect — thanks everyone. Looking forward to Wed. If anything comes up before then I’ll post here. :eyes:
